title: WL-MT405-ConcurrencyEncryptionQuotaHardening
clause: Harden the single-broker working store for concurrent agents, bounded retry, encryption, revocation and disk quotas without creating authority.

conditional_execution.approved: Execute this contract normally after MT-404.
conditional_execution.rejected: Do not edit product code, add a dependency or start a broker; record validator-checked NOT_APPLICABLE_BY_MT401_REJECTION.

scope.summary: GOAL: Make the conditional WP-local adapter safe under simultaneous sessions, MTs and worktrees while retaining MT-403's single Windows broker. The broker owns connections, file locking, conflict classification, bounded retry, quotas, checkpoint/compaction, encryption-key indirection and access revalidation. The evaluated Turso adapter may use documented local MVCC/BEGIN CONCURRENT only after conflict and durability proof; it must never enable cloud sync. Local concurrency can improve working-set throughput but cannot settle canonical conflicts, gates, leases or product revisions.
forbidden_paths: Turso Cloud, remote URLs, auth tokens, push, pull or sync
Raw encryption keys in SurrealDB, local database, config, logs or receipts
Direct file handles outside the broker
Using local locks as canonical Locus occupancy or lease authority
acceptance_criteria: Concurrent requests from at least two worktrees, multiple sessions and multiple MTs under one WP are serialized or run through proven conflict-aware local transactions without corruption, lost updates, starvation or more than one file owner.

Conflict/busy errors are classified, use capped exponential backoff with jitter and a deterministic retry ceiling, and return a typed retryable failure rather than loop indefinitely or bypass the broker.

The evaluated Turso adapter explicitly configures and verifies the chosen local journal/concurrency mode; if MVCC/BEGIN CONCURRENT is unsupported or fails durability tests, the broker uses one-writer serialization instead of silently weakening guarantees.

At-rest encryption is mandatory before any non-public draft, manifest or cache is allowed. The key is generated/stored through the OS secret boundary or approved Handshake key service and referenced by opaque key ID only.
Project/WP membership and ResourceBroker grants are revalidated on open and before sensitive reads/writes; revocation invalidates broker handles and derived cache entries without waiting for restart.

Per-WP hard/soft disk quotas, WAL/checkpoint bounds and retention-aware cleanup prevent unbounded growth. Quota pressure cannot evict pending promotion intents, unpromoted drafts or required recovery receipts.
All broker work is quiet, cancelable and observable through bounded state; it never pops a window or captures focus.
proof_targets: Run a real Windows stress test with concurrent readers/writers from multiple attributed sessions/worktrees, forced conflicts and broker restart; verify hashes, counts and no duplicate ownership.
Run conflict retry ceiling and starvation tests under the chosen Turso local journal mode and under serialized fallback mode.
Inspect the database file for encrypted-at-rest behavior, then prove missing/wrong/revoked key returns typed quarantine without content leakage or file rewrite.
Drive WAL/checkpoint and quota thresholds with bounded synthetic working records and verify deterministic cleanup and protected-record retention.
Revoke a project/WP grant during active use and prove handles, caches and pending calls are denied without widening access.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Concurrency/security backend work; MT-409 owns the visual diagnostic surface. Structured traces expose redacted queue depth, retry class, quota and key-health state.

target_entries: WP-local working store > Parallel agents and broker locking
WP-local working store > Encryption, quotas and access revocation

same_project_private_resource_cases: Concurrent same-project sessions observe only records permitted by their source-scope intersection.
cross_account_negative_cases: Filesystem possession, lock contention and forged handles cannot grant or disclose another account's store.
derived_resource_non_widening_cases: Pending work and conflict retries retain the original source scope and cannot widen it.
revocation_and_context_switch_cases: Revocation invalidates active handles, pending work and derived records promptly and observably.
remote_saas_mcp_sync_cases: Encryption and concurrency support introduce no cloud, SaaS, MCP or replica route.
metadata_side_channel_cases: Counts, quota state, locks, conflicts and diagnostic events are scoped/redacted; opaque key references never reveal key material.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Bounded broker conflict, quota and security lifecycle receipts need correlation without recording payload or key material.
Conflicts, retries, starvation, quota, checkpoint, encryption and revocation require stable redacted diagnostics.
Broker queues, checkpoint/compaction and long contention waits are declared background jobs with cancel/progress state.

risk_if_missed: Concurrent agents can corrupt or starve the local store, plaintext drafts can leak, or an unbounded WAL/cache can exhaust disk and undermine the entire WP.

risks: MVCC is assumed safe without testing conflict/retry behavior on the pinned version.
A broker crash leaves a stale handle/lock and a second writer starts.
Encryption is experimental or misconfigured but diagnostics still label the store protected.
Quota eviction removes the only unpromoted work or logs sensitive filenames.
minimum_controls: Pinned adapter version and real concurrency/durability proof.
Bounded retries, broker generations and single-owner restart protocol.
Fail-closed encryption readiness with key-material scans.

official_sources.title: Turso concurrent writes
official_sources.finding: Official guidance requires MVCC plus BEGIN CONCURRENT and application retry on conflicts; Handshake must bound and prove those retries or serialize writes.

official_sources.title: Turso Rust SDK reference
official_sources.finding: The official reference documents local transactions and encryption, including engine-specific encryption configuration that must fail closed and remain adapter-private.

official_sources.title: SurrealDB permissions and row-level security
official_sources.finding: Canonical permissions remain enforced by authenticated SurrealDB sessions; the broker revalidates rather than inventing local authority.

research_provenance.selected_approach: Single broker with proven local transaction mode, bounded conflict retry, encryption-key indirection, prompt revocation and hard quotas.
